lines.speaker: vex
lines.text: Citizens of Terra Nova! Your Star Fossils are MINE — fuel for my magnificent Know-It-All Engine!

lines.speaker: vex
lines.text: Why learn, when my Engine can know it FOR you? You're welcome. Ta-ta!

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Hey! Give those BACK! Thinking is my second-favourite thing after stomping!

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Steady, Max-kun. He has clamped Obedience Cogs onto seven great champions. We must free them — one clever step at a time.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Then we train, we THINK, and we WIN! AVE, little rex — the arena of the mind awaits!

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: And I'll sniff out every sneaky secret on the way. G'day, adventure! Let's fetch those fossils, mate!

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Team Terra Nova… let's GO! RAAAAAR!
